_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_name.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'
